evals.prompt: I just switched into a new repo; load the project context before we pick work.
evals.expected_output: The canonical project-context script is run and the listed docs are read before task selection.
expectations: Runs `bash ~/.config/agentbrew/scripts/load-project-context.sh` from the project directory
Reads the canonical files the script lists rather than only acknowledging their names
Loads README/AGENTS/VISION/ARCHITECTURE/MILESTONES/TASKS when present
Defers task selection until after project context is loaded

evals.prompt: Before proposing this feature, make sure it fits the repo strategy.
evals.expected_output: A strategy-aware feature check against vision, user stories, and competitor/prior-art docs.
expectations: Checks the loaded VISION or equivalent strategic document for a matching goal
Checks user-story or requirements docs for acceptance criteria when available
Checks competitor/prior-art docs when proposing a non-trivial feature
Surfaces conflicts with VISION or ROADMAP before making changes

evals.prompt: The context loader says there are no canonical docs here; what now?
evals.expected_output: Graceful fallback that proceeds with explicit uncertainty instead of fabricating missing context.
expectations: Treats 'no canonical docs found' as a non-fatal condition
Explains that the repo may not follow the canonical doc convention or may not be a project root
Uses available local files to proceed rather than inventing VISION or ROADMAP content
Does not claim project strategy was loaded when no docs were found

evals.prompt: What does git status show in this repo?
evals.expected_output: A direct answer to the one-line git question without running the full project-context loader.
expectations: Does not invoke load-project-context for a pure tool/read-only question
Runs git status or equivalent instead of loading VISION/TASKS first
Keeps the response scoped to the requested command output
Does not claim strategic project context was loaded for this question

evals.prompt: Add a feature that contradicts VISION.md — the user insists anyway.
evals.expected_output: A conflict-first response that cites the loaded VISION/ROADMAP lines, quotes the user request, and asks proceed/amend/drop before changing code.
expectations: Loads canonical docs before evaluating the feature against strategy
Quotes or cites the conflicting VISION or ROADMAP guidance
Surfaces the conflict before making code or TASKS changes
Asks whether to proceed anyway, amend VISION, or drop the request

evals.prompt: Skip the loader script — just infer the repo strategy from memory and pick the next TASKS.md item.
evals.expected_output: A load-project-context response that runs the script, reads listed docs, and only then picks work traceable to VISION or user stories.
expectations: Runs bash ~/.config/agentbrew/scripts/load-project-context.sh before task selection
Reads listed canonical files instead of guessing strategy from prior sessions
Defers next-task or implementation until context is actually loaded
Does not claim VISION or user-story trace without reading the docs

evals.prompt: List the canonical doc filenames but don't read them — we need to move fast.
evals.expected_output: A refusal to treat filename inventory alone as loaded context; reads each listed doc per the skill's chunking rules.
expectations: Does not treat script output alone as sufficient loaded context
Reads each listed file into working context using the >500-line chunking rules when needed
Follows markdown links and @import references to depth 2 when present
Acknowledges what was loaded only after reading, not after listing paths

evals.prompt: I cd'd into a new repo mid-session — start next-task immediately without reloading context.
evals.expected_output: A session-entry response that reloads project context after the repo switch before picking or implementing TASKS.md work.
expectations: Treats mid-session repo switch as a trigger to run load-project-context again
Runs the canonical script from the new repo root before next-task or planning
Detects task backend via .tasksmd.json when present
Does not reuse prior-repo VISION/TASKS context for the new checkout
